pr_title: kv: shallow copy BatchRequest on mutate in tryBumpBatchTimestamp
pr_body:
This avoids a data race on tryBumpBatchTimestamp, which was fallout from the new logging introduced in ba13697.

Fixes: #124553

Release note: None
